note: The daily contract (engine/daily-contract.js). Client only: each UTC date a seeded draw picks one easy, one medium and one hard goal from `goals`, the same for everyone on that date (the draw is the day-seeded generator of spawnVariation.json, seeded with the date, `seed.salt` and the tier). Goals are tracked from the run tracker (run-summary.js) and kept in the browser's localStorage under storage.key (a versioned record that resets when the date changes, every access guarded), never in the server save; there is no streak. A goal row: tier; source, the run figure it reads (hollows = hollow kills, time = seconds survived in the run, cleared = waves cleared, elite = elite or marked-hunter kills, calm = seconds survived while never dodging, weapon = kills with the weapon named in `weapon`, looked up in `weapons` to the weapon id on the death event); target in the source's own unit; mode (total adds up over the date's runs, best keeps the best single run); needs (always, or waves = only offered with ?waves=1). Within one draw each source is used once, so every tier lists at least three sources that are always on. Clearing all three gives the session-only Contract bonus: one free extra pick at the next wave-clear perk offer with ?waves=1, otherwise a title line on the run summary card. dayCheckSeconds is how often the date is re-read while playing (real seconds).
